lines.text: Morning or afternoon. Either way, hello.
Hey. Coffee's on. Pour yourself one.
{player}. I fixed that thing you mentioned.
{player}. Good. I could use a hand. Or company. Either.
Morning. Frost on the windshields today.
Night. Roads are slick after nine.
Call if you need anything. I mean it.
Fixed the neighbor's fence. Took an hour.
Tire pressure drops in the cold. Check yours.
Hamilton's getting repaved. Detours all week.
Hardware store's got a sale on drill bits.
The new bridge in Carrburg was built right. Good welds.
Saw a red-tailed hawk by the ravine.
Coffee's coffee. Don't need it fancy.
Changed my oil today. Saves money.
Built a bookshelf. Holds four hundred pounds.
You're alright, {player}. I don't say that much.
Not a talker. But I'm glad you're around.
If your car breaks down, call me. Not a tow truck.
I trust you. That's rare for me.
I'd help you move. That's friendship.
I made you a key to the shop. In case.
Sunday's for rest. Mostly I fix things.
Grew up on a farm. Learned to fix what breaks.
My dad didn't talk much. Neither do I.
I build furniture in my garage. Oak, mostly.
Served four years. Came back. Settled here.
I don't like fuss. I like things that work.
I read at night. History. Westerns.
{place}. Wiring's old. Someone should look at it.
I don't come to {place} much. It's alright.
Say that again and we'll have a problem.
This is good quality. Thank you.
Why'd the mechanic sleep under the car? Wanted to wake up oily.
I have a joke about construction. Still working on it.
Duct tape can't fix stupid. But it can muffle it.
My wrench and I have a lot in common. We both like to tighten things up.
Can you give me a ride to the shop? Truck's in the lift.
Help me move a dresser Saturday? I'll buy lunch.
Customer brought a car with a squirrel in the engine. Squirrel's fine.
Didn't go to college. Learned on the job.
Took a welding course at the community college. Worth it.
School's important. I tell my nephew.
I've got nothing to say to you.
You're making me smile. That's hard.
I like you too. Thought you should know.
Hey. Got here early. Checked the place out.
Brought you something. From the shop. It's a keychain.
I think about you more than I should.
Not good with words. But I like you. A lot.
You've got a good head on your shoulders. And a nice smile.
Know a place by the lake. Quiet.
Don't like crowds. Do like you.
I cooked. Steak. It's the one thing I make right.
Built a bench by the river. Want to see it?
You want to learn to drive stick? I'll teach you.
I'm a simple person. Hope that's okay.
Never told anyone this. I like poetry. Some of it.
I'd like to keep seeing you.
You're good company. Best I've had.
Shop was quiet without you around.
I'm not jealous. Just paying attention.
I'm not good at this. Say what you need.
I'm not going anywhere. But we need to fix this.
Yes. Been waiting for you to ask. Or for me to.
Up early. Fixed the squeaky hinge.
Coffee's on the counter. Black, like always. Well, with your sugar.
Hey. Weather's turning. Wear a coat.
Evening. Sit. I'll get you a drink.
Want to talk, or just sit?
You're the best thing in my life.
Don't say it much. Mean it every day.
You make this house a home.
You're steady. Like me. Better than me.
Not a lot of words. A lot of love.
You're the reason I come home.
I'll always take care of you.
I see you. All of you.
Gutters need cleaning. I'll do it Saturday.
Built a new shelf for the garage.
Furnace needs a filter. Bought one.
Neighbor's tree is leaning. Talked to him.
Car needs new brakes. I'll do it.
Snow's coming. Got the shovels ready.
Saw a deer in the yard this morning.
Water heater's making noise. I'll look at it.
Back porch needs sealing. Next weekend.
Made a new cutting board. Walnut.
Lawn mower's running better. Sharpened the blade.
Window in the bedroom sticks. Planed it.
Bought a new toolbox. The old one rusted.
Found a mouse in the garage. Relocated him.
I like this house. Built right.
Don't need to buy that. I can build it.
Fixed it myself. Saved two hundred.
Bonus came in. Put it in savings.
Fried fish. Caught it this morning.
I don't like how you said that.
Going for a walk. Need to think.
I can't fix this one alone.
I love you. That doesn't change.
You don't have to say anything.
Whatever it is, we'll handle it.
I'll fix what I can. Rest.
Want to drive to the mountains?
Thought we'd fix up the porch together.
Let's go to the county fair.
Could build a garden bed. Spring.
Drive to the coast. Just us.
Want to see the old train station in Carrburg?
Remember when we met? At the hardware store.
Remember our first date? You ordered for both of us.
Remember the wedding? I said four words. All true.
Remember when the truck broke down on the highway?
Built you that bench. Our first summer.
Remember the first winter here? Pipes froze.
Remember when you laughed at me fixing the sink? I was soaked.
Remember the cabin? No power. Best week.
First time you said you loved me, I couldn't speak.
Remember fixing up this place? Took two years.
Made you something. A box. Walnut.
Love you more than last year.
Took the day off. For you.
You can't back up a trailer.
You never put the tools back.
You think everything needs a professional.
You always want to stop and ask directions.
You laugh at my one joke. Every time.
